'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***[[Ukraine]] says that it damaged the [[Russia]]n tanker [[Sig (tanker)|''Sig'']] in a [[Ukrainian Navy|naval]] [[drone attack]] in the [[Black Sea]] near the [[Crimean Bridge]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66412842.amp (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/aug/05/russian-chemical-tanker-reportedly-hit-by-ukraine-drones-in-kerch-strait (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Peace talks begin in [[Jeddah]], [[Saudi Arabia]]. The talks will last for two days and are being attended by officials from around 40 countries, including those from the [[Global South]], but not Russia. [https://www.reuters.com/world/ukraine-expects-difficult-successful-talks-saudi-arabia-2023-08-05/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/08/05/world/europe/ukraine-war-saudi-arabia-russia.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Russia hits a [[blood transfusion]] centre in [[Kupiansk]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]], killing two people and injuring four. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66419331 (BBC News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A gunman opens fire on a street in [[Tel Aviv]], [[Israel]], killing a policeman, before being shot dead by another officer. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/5/shooter-kills-tel-aviv-policeman-in-israel-suspect-gunned-down (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 17 people are killed and 18 others are missing in a [[landslide]] in [[Shovi]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-landslide-shovi-racha-dead/32534083.html (Radio Free Europe)]

***The [[Philippine Coast Guard]] accuses the [[China Coast Guard]] of firing [[water cannon]]s at its vessels near the [[Second Thomas Shoal]] in the [[Spratly Islands]] where [[Armed Forces of the Philippines|Filipino military]] personnel are stationed. '''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2023 Cambodian general election]]
**The [[National Election Committee]] declares a [[landslide victory]] for [[Prime Minister of Cambodia|Prime Minister]] [[Hun Sen]]'s [[Cambodian People's Party]], which won 120 of the 125 seats in the [[Parliament of Cambodia|parliament]]. The [[royalist]] [[FUNCINPEC]] party secured the remaining five seats. [https://apnews.com/article/cambodia-election-result-hun-sen-victory-494671e58e41a0784b216635cd3c3d39 (AP)]
